{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify and handle sentinel value (-999.0) in biomarker_baseline
# Replace -999.0 with NaN to indicate missing data
df['biomarker_baseline'] = df['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Compute the mean of biomarker_baseline, excluding sentinel values
mean_baseline = df['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL): {mean_baseline}")"}
